title: Shop
subtitle: Tools and equipment delivered to your door, at one price. We check with the supplier, buy, and bring it to you.
askInstead: Tell us what you need instead.
customsIncluded: Delivered price. Customs estimated at {amount}, included.
howItWorks: Once you confirm, we check the price and stock with the supplier and send you the quote by email. You pay only once you accept it.
signedOut: Buying needs a free account, so we know who to deliver to and can reply.
staff: Staff accounts can't buy from the shop.

done.title: Order {reference} received.
done.body: We check with the supplier and email you the quote shortly. The link below follows your order until it's at your door.
